title: llama.cpp changes since b10751
scope: Every llama.cpp change between build b10751 and the newest build (about b11028, 2026-09-22) that matters to a Windows desktop harness: new or changed server and CLI flags, speculative decoding types, router / multi-model mode, tool calling and MCP support in llama-server, reasoning controls, multimodal (mtmd) and audio input, KV cache features, performance changes on CUDA Ampere, Windows release assets. Cite the PRs and release notes.

title: Newest open models worth offering
scope: Open-weight models released or updated in August-September 2026 that a local harness should offer in a one-click catalog: text and coding (Qwen 3.x MoE and dense, Gemma 4 family, Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Phi, others), vision-language, embeddings. For each: GGUF availability and best quantizations, size, context length, licence and gating, and whether it fits an 8 GB GPU + 32 GB RAM laptop (and how: fully in VRAM or MoE experts on CPU).

title: Local image generation backends
scope: Running image generation locally inside a desktop harness on Windows with an 8 GB NVIDIA GPU: stable-diffusion.cpp current state (FLUX, SD 3.5, SDXL, Qwen-Image, Wan video, GGUF image models, CUDA and Vulkan builds, server/API mode), ComfyUI headless API mode (installed locally at C:/Users/noahm/AppData/Local/Comfy-Desktop), other embeddable engines; speed per image at 1024px, VRAM needs, img2img/inpainting/upscaling support, model licences (FLUX dev vs schnell etc.), and how LM Studio, Jan and others handle (or lack) image generation.

title: Local speech-to-text and text-to-speech
scope: Best local speech stack for a Windows desktop harness in late 2026: speech-to-text (whisper.cpp and its server mode, faster-whisper, NVIDIA Parakeet, Moonshine, Kyutai STT, llama.cpp audio input), text-to-speech (Kokoro, Piper, Orpheus, Dia, Kyutai TTS, Chatterbox and newer), streaming latency on an RTX 3070 Ti laptop, model sizes and licences, and voice-mode designs (push-to-talk, barge-in).

title: Hugging Face one-click downloads
scope: How a desktop app should implement LM Studio-style one-click model downloads from Hugging Face: the Hub HTTP API for search, model cards and file listing, resolve URLs, resumable range downloads, the Xet storage backend and its effect on plain HTTP clients (downloads stalling at 0 bytes via hf download has been observed on this machine), gated models and user access tokens, rate limits, checksums (LFS sha256), mirrors, and how LM Studio, Jan and Ollama do it. Include licence display requirements.

title: MCP and plugin ecosystems
scope: Latest Model Context Protocol spec and SDKs (Rust and TypeScript), how desktop hosts install and run MCP servers (Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LM Studio MCP support, DSH Desktop plugins), plugin packaging and one-click install patterns, registries, sandboxing and permission models for plugins, known MCP security problems (tool poisoning, rug pulls, prompt injection through tool output) and mitigations, and the most useful MCP servers today including image generation.

title: Tool permission systems
scope: How Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, opencode, Cline, Gemini CLI and Cursor implement tool permissions in 2026: modes (ask, allow for session, always, deny, auto), rule syntax, approval UI, command and file-diff previews, sandboxing of shell commands on Windows, audit logs, and what users praise and complain about.

title: Tauri v2 and WebView2 state
scope: Tauri v2 latest release (2.11 and newer): security features (capabilities, isolation pattern, CSP), updater signing, sidecar processes for bundled binaries (llama-server, stable-diffusion.cpp, whisper.cpp), IPC streaming performance, WebView2 on Windows 11, SolidJS integration, installer formats (MSI, NSIS), and known pitfalls.

title: What rivals shipped recently
scope: Features and releases from August-September 2026 for LM Studio, Ollama, Jan, AnythingLLM, KoboldCpp, Open WebUI, Msty, goose, Cline and DSH Desktop.

title: Self-verification and reasoning effort
scope: Research and practice from 2025-2026 on making small local models verify their own work and on user-selectable reasoning effort: reasoning budgets and effort levels in open models (Qwen, gpt-oss, DeepSeek), self-verification and self-refine effectiveness and failure modes, multi-path self-consistency, generative verifiers, concise-answer (low verbosity) prompting and its effect on accuracy, and the token/time cost of each at batch 1.

title: Local memory and document search
scope: The newest practical approaches (2026) for persistent cross-chat memory and local document search in a desktop assistant: memory extraction and editing UX, embedding and reranker models that run locally via llama.cpp, hybrid search, Rust-native vector stores, document parsing on Windows, and privacy controls.

title: New security issues in local AI tools
scope: Security vulnerabilities, advisories and incidents published August-September 2026 affecting llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, Open WebUI, ComfyUI, MCP servers and hosts, Tauri/WebView2 apps, and AI coding agents; what attack techniques are trending (prompt injection through tools, malicious model files, DNS rebinding, supply chain) and the recommended mitigations.
